headlines.title: Are Wall Street Analysts Predicting Duke Energy Stock Will Climb or Sink?
headlines.summary: Duke Energy has underperformed the S&P 500 Index over the past year, but analysts are cautiously optimistic about the stock’s prospects.

headlines.title: Duke Energy (DUK) Stock Looks Fully Valued Despite Its 62% Run
headlines.summary: Duke Energy has delivered steady share gains in recent years, and the stock closed at US$127.78 on the latest trading day. With the utility also known for its regular payouts, the live question is whether that price can be justified by the dividend stream investors are paying for today. Over the past 3 years, Duke Energy has returned 62.1%, which puts real weight on whether the underlying dividends are strong enough to support that kind of shareholder experience.

headlines.title: Recognizing Entrepreneurial Achievements in the Greater Tampa Bay Area
headlines.summary: Prospera hosted its annual entrepreneurship celebration, presented by Duke Energy, at The Florida Aquarium. This year's theme, 35 Years Rooted in Impact, brought together Prospera's sponsors and partners to recognize three local businesses whose growth and contributions to the region have increased with the organization's guidance and services.

description: Duke Energy Corporation, through its subsidiaries, operates as an energy company in the United States. The company operates through two segments: Electric Utilities and Infrastructure (EU&I); and Gas Utilities and Infrastructure (GU&I). The EU&I segment generates, transmits, distributes, and sells electricity to customers in the Southeast and Midwest regions. It generates electricity through coal, hydroelectric, natural gas, oil, renewables, and nuclear fuel. This segment also engages in the wholesale of electricity to municipalities, electric cooperative utilities, and other load-serving entities. The GU&I segment distributes natural gas to customers in the residential, commercial, industrial, and power generation natural gas sectors; and invests in pipeline transmission projects, renewable natural gas projects, and natural gas storage facilities. The company was formerly known as Duke Energy Holding Corp. and changed its name to Duke Energy Corporation in April 2006. Duke Energy Corporation was founded in 1904 and is headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina.
